blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: At large events, pedestrian tracking supports entrance and passageway counts, but totals hide which crossings were missed. In a stadium study, the system recorded about four in five clearly visible crossings but fewer than one in three mostly obscured crossings. The videos lacked trajectories annotated across frames, so we turned to MOT20, which provides pedestrian trajectories and visibility. We introduce GateTrace to locate missed crossings and assess changes to counting rules. It derives reference crossings from annotations under fixed rules, matches reports by person, direction, time and position, and traces misses through saved boxes and counting decisions. With a shared detector, ByteTrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT recover 38.9-46.7% of low-visibility reference crossings on development sequences, versus 98.1-99.0% at high visibility. The gap recurs on two further sequences under a protocol fixed in advance. Published outputs of MOT20-tuned BASE recover 63-78% at low visibility across both sequence groups. Losses stop at different stages across systems. Across four systems and both groups, 47-79% of low-visibility misses have no nearby output linked to the person or no possible crossing in the saved tracks. Removing later checks from BASE on development sequences leaves most misses unresolved and lowers precision against the fixed reference list from about 96% to 77%. Misses also remain among sampled reference crossings that two human annotators supported after checking the videos. GateTrace shows where crossings are lost and measures the recovery and precision costs of changing later checks. We will release the code and per-crossing records.
blocks.zh: 在大型活动时,行人追踪支持入口和通道的清点,但总数掩盖了错过的过境点。 在一项体育场研究中,该系统记录了五个明显可见的过境点中大约四个,但三个大多模糊不清的过境点中不到一个。 影片缺乏横跨框架的图轨, 所以我们转向了MOT20, 它提供了行人图轨和可见度。 我们引进了GateTrace 来定位缺失的过境点 并评估计票规则的变化 它从固定规则的说明、按个人、方向、时间和位置分列的报告以及通过保存的方框和计数决定而丢失的痕迹中调出参考资料。 使用共享探测器,ByteTrack,OC-SORT和BOT-SORT在开发序列上回收38.9%-46.7%的低可见度参考过路量,而高可见度时回收率为98.1-99.0%. 差距在预先确定的协议下再出现两个序列。 MOT20-Tuned BASE的公布产出在两个序列组的低能见度下恢复了63%-78%. 损失在各个系统的不同阶段停止。 在4个系统和两个组中,47%至79%的低能见度缺失与该人没有关联,或无法通过已保存的轨道。 取消BASE对开发序列的后期检查,使大多数问题得不到解决,使固定参考清单的精确度从96%降至77%。 Misses还是两个人类注释员在检查录像后支持的抽样参考过境点之一。 门 追踪显示过境点丢失之处,并衡量改变后期检查的回收和精确成本。 我们将发布代码和每条过境记录。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: For tracking-based crowd-flow monitoring, a count begins with a person’s trajectory through an entrance or passageway. A counting rule converts that trajectory into a report of when and in which direction the person crossed a virtual line. Occlusion can interrupt the trajectory or cause it to switch between people. A missing report then leaves no entry in the final count to inspect. To understand the omission, we need to identify the missing crossing and examine the steps that should have produced its report.
blocks.zh: 对于基于跟踪的人群流量监测,计数从一个人通过入口或通道的轨迹开始。 计数规则将轨迹转换成一个人何时何方向越过虚拟线的报告. 闭塞会干扰轨迹,或导致其在人与人之间切换. 报告缺失后,最后统计中没有任何内容可供检查。 为了理解这一遗漏,我们需要查明缺失的过境点,并审查本应产生其报告的步骤。

blocks.en: Our work was motivated by a video-based study of pedestrian flow at tunnel entrances in a football stadium. A tracker assigns each person a person-ID and tries to keep that ID across frames. In crowded scenes, however, we observed tracks switching between people or breaking into fragments, with crossings missing from the count. In comparisons by time and position, the YOLOX composite described in Sec. 4, adapted to the stadium’s gate geometry and height model, matched 103 of 129 clearly visible crossings but only 40 of 138 crossings where the person was mostly obscured (Supplement F). The manual crossing annotations did not follow each person across frames, so we could not reliably check whether each report belonged to the correct person. To investigate these missed crossings, we turned to MOT20 [ 2 ] , a public dataset of crowded scenes with the annotations needed for this check. These include pedestrian boxes, IDs that remain consistent across frames, and visibility values describing how much of each person can be seen.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作受到足球场隧道入口行人流量视频研究的推动。 追踪器为每个人分配一个个人身份,并试图保持该身份跨帧. 然而,在拥挤的场景中,我们观察到人与人之间的轨道变换或破碎,而伯爵中缺少过境点。 在按时间和位置进行比较时,第4节中描述的YOLOX复合材料符合体育场的大门几何和高度模型,匹配了129个明显可见的过境点中的103个,但在138个过境点中只有40个,而这些人大多是模糊不清的(补充F)。 手册的过境说明没有遵循每个人跨框架,因此我们无法可靠地检查每份报告是否属于正确的人。 为了调查这些漏掉的过境点,我们转向了MOT20[2],这是一个由拥挤场景组成的公共数据集,上面有本次检查所需的说明. 其中包括行人箱、保持横框一致的身份证、以及说明每人有多少人能看到的可见值。

blocks.en: GateTrace first lists the crossings derived from these annotations, then checks which ones have corresponding system reports. We define a region on either side of a virtual counting line; together, these form a counting gate. Fixed rules applied to annotated trajectories produce the reference list. On tracker outputs at the same gates, fixed rules find transitions between regions as possible crossings, which later checks retain or discard. A reference crossing counts as recovered when a system report matches it by person, direction, time and position. For every unmatched reference, GateTrace examines the saved boxes and counting decisions to locate where the report was lost.
blocks.zh: GateTrace首先列出这些说明中衍生出来的过境点,然后检查哪些过境点有相应的系统报告. 我们在虚拟计数线的两侧划定一个区域;这些区域共同构成计数门。 适用于注释轨迹的固定规则产生参考列表. 在同一关口的跟踪器输出上,固定规则发现区域之间的过渡是可能的过境点,而后检查是否保留。 如果系统报告按个人、方向、时间和位置加以匹配,则参考过境点即算收回。 对于每一个无与伦比的参考文献,GateTrace检查了保存的方框,并计数决定了报告丢失的地点.

blocks.en: Two examples from the BASE tracker in Fig. 1 show why a missed crossing can require different checks. In the first, all saved positions on a track lie in the region the person entered. The counting procedure has no transition between regions to report. In the second, the track produces a possible crossing, but the check of how far it enters the destination region (the depth check) rejects it. Relaxing this check can affect the second case; the first still has no possible crossing to accept. GateTrace distinguishes these cases when evaluating changes to the counting rules.
blocks.zh: 图片1中的BASE追踪器有两个例子,说明为什么错过过关需要不同的检查. 首先,所有在轨道上节省下来的位置都位于该人进入的区域。 计算程序在各区域之间没有过渡报告。 第二段中,赛道产生可能的过关,但检查它进入目的地区域有多远(深度检查)则拒绝. 放松这种检查会影响第二个案件;第一个案件仍然无法通过。 门 Trace在评价计数规则的变化时区分了这些情况.

blocks.en: We evaluate ByteTrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] with one shared YOLOX detector trained without MOT20 and the authors’ MOT17 settings. On the development sequences, more than half of low-visibility reference crossings have no matching report, while almost all high-visibility crossings are recovered. The gap recurs on two further sequences under a protocol fixed in advance. Published outputs of BASE [ 6 ] , whose parameters were fitted on MOT20, recover more low-visibility crossings but retain a gap between visibility groups. BASE’s results on the two further sequences were scored after the fixed confirmation study.
blocks.zh: 我们评估ByteTrack、OC-SORT和BOT-SORT[3、4、5],有一个共享的YOLOX探测器在没有MOT20和提交人的MOT17设置的情况下得到训练。 在开发序列上,一半以上的低可见度参考口岸没有匹配报告,而几乎所有高可见度口岸都被收回. 差距在预先确定的协议下再出现两个序列。 BASE[6]的公布产出(其参数已安装在MOT20上)恢复了更低可见度的过境点,但能见度群体之间仍有差距。 BASE在另外两个序列上的结果是在固定确认研究之后得分的.

blocks.en: These systems lose crossings at different stages. Across four systems and both sequence groups, the largest share of low-visibility misses has no nearby tracker output linked to the person or no possible crossing produced from that output. Later checks act on possible crossings already found in the saved tracks. These records therefore distinguish misses that later checks can affect from those that require an earlier change.
blocks.zh: 这些系统在不同阶段失去过境点。 在4个系统和两个序列组中,在低可见度缺失中,最大的一部分没有与该人员有关的近距离跟踪器输出,或者没有通过该输出可能产生的过路。 之后对已保存的轨道中发现的可能过境点进行检查。 因此,这些记录区分了以后可能影响到的遗漏和需要提前更改的遗漏。

blocks.en: To test the effect of relaxing these checks, we keep BASE’s tracks and the reference list fixed and remove all checks after possible crossings form. On the development sequences, this recovers only a small share of missed low-visibility crossings and adds unmatched reports. Precision, the fraction of all reports matching the fixed list, consequently falls.
blocks.zh: 为了检验放松这些检查的效果,我们将BASE的跟踪和参考清单固定下来,并在可能的过境表格之后删除所有检查。 在发展顺序方面,这只恢复了少部分失明的低可见度过境点,并增加了未匹配的报告。 因此,精确度,即所有报告与固定清单相符的比例下降。

blocks.en: These comparisons depend on the reference list. Full-body annotation boxes include occluded body parts, so a crossing derived from them can occur while the person’s feet are hidden. Two annotators therefore reviewed the videos to judge whether each sampled crossing happened, in which direction, and whether the same person appeared on both sides. They assessed timing separately. Of the 18 low-visibility crossings both annotators initially supported on the first three questions, ByteTrack still misses eight and BASE three. Each evaluated system misses at most one of the 18 supported high-visibility crossings.
blocks.zh: 这些比较取决于参考列表. 全身注解盒中包括了被吞噬的身体部分,因此,当人的脚被隐藏时,可以进行由它们衍生出来的交叉. 因此,两名注释员审查了这些录像,以判断每个抽样的过境点是否都发生了,朝哪个方向,以及是否在两侧出现同一人。 他们分别评估了时间安排。 在18个低能见度的过境点中,最初在前三个问题上都支持的注释员,ByteTrack仍然错过了8个和BASE 3个。 在18个支助的高可见度过境点中,每个受评价的系统最多都漏了一个。

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: • GateTrace matches crossings from annotated tracks to reports and traces misses hidden by total counts. • Across four MOT20 sequences, three trackers sharing one detector miss over half of low-visibility crossings but few high-visibility ones. Published outputs of MOT20-tuned BASE still miss about 22–37% of low-visibility crossings across both sequence groups. These results support evaluating crossing recovery by visibility. • Later checks offer limited recovery. In four systems on both sequence groups, 47–79% of low-visibility misses lack nearby output linked to the person or a crossing found in saved tracks. Removing later checks on development data adds few low-visibility matches for BASE and ByteTrack and lowers precision against fixed references.
blocks.zh: • GateTraces从附加说明的轨道到报告和全部计数所隐藏的缺失的痕迹,将过境点相匹配。 • 在四个MOT20序列中,共用一个探测器的3个跟踪器错过了一半以上的低可见度过境点,但高可见度过境点很少。 MOT20-Tuned BASE的公布产出仍然错过了大约22-37%的低能见度跨越两个序列组。 这些成果有助于通过能见度评价跨度恢复情况。 • 支助 以后的检查只能提供有限的补偿。 在两个序列组的四个系统中,47-79%的低可见度缺失了与被保存轨道中的人或一个过路口相连的附近输出。 取消以后对开发数据的检查增加了很少BASE和ByteTrack的低能见度匹配,并降低了相对于固定引用的精确度.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Tracking evaluation in crowds. MOTChallenge [ 7 ] and MOT20 [ 2 ] provide standard settings for pedestrian tracking, and HOTA [ 8 ] balances detection, association and localization. MOTCOM [ 11 ] describes sequence difficulty through occlusion, motion and appearance; CrowdTrack [ 14 ] focuses on difficult pedestrian tracking in real scenes. Sundararaman et al. track pedestrian heads in dense crowds [ 22 ] . Frame metrics grouped by visibility already show degradation under occlusion. We examine how this affects crossing reports and locate where each crossing is lost.
blocks.zh: 在人群中跟踪评价. MOTChallenge[7]和MOT20[2]提供了行人跟踪的标准设置,HOTA[8]平衡检测,关联和本地化. MOTCOM [11]通过隔离,运动和外观来描述序列困难; CrowdTrack [14] 专注于真实场景中困难的行人追踪. 孙达拉曼等. 在密集人群中追踪行人头部[22]. 按能见度分类的框架指标已经显示在隔离下退化。 我们审查这如何影响过境报告,并确定每个过境点丢失的地点。

blocks.en: Events and line crossing. Roth et al. evaluated trackers on derived events and event recovery for each object [ 9 , 23 ] . Ma and Chan counted line crossings with local features [ 10 ] , AdaLine optimizes counting-line placement [ 15 ] , and ByteTraX reports line counts [ 16 ] . Pouw et al. benchmark pedestrian-flow and trajectory measurements [ 1 ] . These studies establish crossing events as an evaluation target. Video individual counting estimates the number of distinct pedestrians from inflow and outflow between frames, without tracking [ 24 , 25 ] . GateTrace evaluates tracker outputs by matching each crossing report to the annotated person, grouping results by visibility, and examining the tracking and counting records for every miss.
blocks.zh: 事件和横线。 罗斯等人. 评估每个物体的衍生事件和事件恢复的跟踪器[9、23]。 马和灿统计有本地特色的线路过境[10],阿达琳优化计票线路布局[15],ByteTraX报告线路计数[16]. Pouw等人基准行人流量和轨迹测量 [1]. 这些研究将跨越活动确定为评价目标。 视频个人计数估算出不同行人从帧间流入和流出的人数,不跟踪[24,25]. 门 Trace通过将每个交叉报告与注释人匹配,按能见度对结果进行分组,以及检查每个错失的跟踪和计数记录来评价跟踪器输出.

blocks.en: Error analysis. TIDE separates detection errors into categories [ 17 ] , Detecting Invisible People evaluates interventions for occluded people [ 18 ] , CAST examines association errors over time [ 12 ] , and Perception Characteristics Distance relates perception quality to a decision rule [ 13 ] . GateTrace applies this view to crowd-flow crossing reports.
blocks.zh: 错误分析。 TIDE将检测错误分为[17]类,检测 隐形人评价对被占有者的干预[18], CAST审查随时间推移而出现的关联错误[12],而感知特征 距离将感知质量与决定规则[13]联系起来. 门 Trace将这一观点应用于人群流动过境报告.

blocks.en: 3 The GateTrace framework
blocks.zh: 3 门轨框架

blocks.en: GateTrace evaluates individual crossing reports in four steps (Fig. 2 ). It builds a reference list from annotated trajectories using fixed gate rules (Sec. 3.1), applies counting rules to each tracker’s output at the same gates (Sec. 3.2), and matches reports to references by person, direction, time and position (Sec. 3.3). For each unmatched reference, it checks whether nearby boxes could be linked to that person, whether those tracks produced a possible crossing, and whether later checks kept it (Sec. 3.4).
blocks.zh: GateTrace分四个步骤(图2 )评价个别的过境报告. 它利用固定大门规则(Sec.3.1)从附加说明的轨迹建立参考清单,对每个追踪器在同一大门的输出适用计数规则(Sec.3.2),并按人、方向、时间和位置将报告与参考物相匹配(Sec.3.3)。 对于每个未匹配的参考,它检查附近的盒子是否可以与该人联系起来,这些铁轨是否产生可能的过关,以及后来的检查是否保留(第3.4条)。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : How GateTrace checks crossing reports. (A) Annotated trajectories provide reference crossings and a height model for each sequence. (B) Counting rules find possible crossings in tracker outputs, check them and save the intermediate decisions. (C) Reports are matched to references by person, direction, time and position to calculate crossing recall and precision. (D) For each missed reference, a record connects nearby output boxes, possible crossings and counting decisions. Human judgments are reported separately.

blocks.zh: 3.1 交叉引用

Gate sizes follow the apparent body height at their position. We fit an affine model of box height against image position for each sequence and predict the height h m h_{m} at each gate midpoint. Each gate has two adjacent rectangular regions of depth h m h_{m} , separated by a gap of half-width 0.05 ​ h m 0.05h_{m} .

blocks.en: We record a transition when a person first appears in the region opposite their last region assignment. A gap longer than 0.5 s resets that assignment; we do not interpolate missing positions. We include a transition in the reference list when a point reaches at least 0.2 times its annotated box height into the destination region between entry and 50 frames later, inclusive (Supplement F.3). We keep the excluded transitions for the analyses in Sec. 5.3. Crossing visibility is the person’s mean annotated visibility within ± \pm 25 frames ( ± \pm 1 s), grouped into [ 0 , .25 ) [0,.25) , [ .25 , .5 ) [.25,.5) , [ .5 , .75 ) [.5,.75) and [ .75 , 1 ] [.75,1] .
blocks.zh: 我们记录了一个过渡,当一个人第一次出现在地区时,他们与最后的区域任务相反。 超过0.5的空档重新填补这一任务;我们不插入缺失的位置。 当某一点至少达到注解框高度的0.2倍时,我们在参考清单中列入一个过渡,从进入到50个框之间,包括以后(补充F.3)。 我们把排除的过渡 用于分析第5.3节。 交叉可见度是该人物在 ±\pm 25 帧(±\pm 1 s)内的平均附加说明可见度,分为 [0, 25] [0, 25] [0. 25, 5] [25, 5, 75] [5, 75] 和 [.75, 1] [75, 1].

blocks.en: 3.2 Turning tracks into crossing reports
blocks.zh: 3.2 将轨道转换为交叉报告

blocks.en: We apply the counting rules to each output track, using the bottom centers of its boxes (except for the composite and oracle; Sec. 4). Each transition between the gate regions marks a possible crossing. We check and group these before reporting them.
blocks.zh: 我们对每个输出轨道应用计数规则,使用其箱底中心(复合体和甲骨文除外;sec.4)。 大门地区之间的每一个过渡都标志着可能的过境。 我们先检查一下,然后把它们组起来,然后报告

blocks.en: The depth check requires the track to reach 0.2 predicted body heights into the destination region within the next 2 s of the same track fragment. We merge same-track, same-direction events at most 2 s apart. For each group, we examine only valid points assigned to either region. In the one-second windows before and after the group, at least half must lie in the source and destination regions, respectively; groups with fewer than three in either window are kept and flagged. The remaining events are final crossing reports. We save these possible crossings, measured depths, groups and final decisions.
blocks.zh: 深度检查要求赛道在同一赛道碎片的下2秒内达到0.2预测的车身高度进入目的地区域. 我们把同一轨道,同一方向的事件合并在一起 最多分开2次 对于每个集团,我们只审查分配给两个区域的有效要点。 在组合前后的一秒钟窗口中,至少一半必须分别位于来源区和目的地区;两个窗口中少于三个的组必须保存并标注. 其余事件是最后过境报告。 我们拯救了这些可能的过境点、有限度的深度、团体和最后决定。

blocks.en: 3.3 Matching reports to the correct person
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 将报告与正确的人匹配

blocks.en: To determine which annotated person a report describes, we use its track’s boxes within ± \pm 25 frames of the event. We match as many output and annotated boxes as possible one-to-one at IoU ≥ \geq 0.5, where IoU is box intersection over union. We link a matched box to that person only when its overlap exceeds the best competing person’s by at least 0.10. Each linked box votes for that person’s ID. The event receives the most frequent person-ID if it has votes from at least half of all observations (at least three). If the IDs before and after the event conflict, we mark the person assignment as mixed.
blocks.zh: 为了确定报告描述的是哪个注解人物,我们用它的音轨框在 ±\pm 25 个事件框内. 我们在IoU \ geq 0.5 尽可能多地匹配输出和附加说明的框,IoU 的框交叉点是结合点。 我们只当一个匹配的盒子的重叠程度超过最佳竞争对手时,才将该人链接到至少0.10。 每个人的身份证都连在一起。 如果该事件获得至少半数(至少三次)观察结果的选票,则该事件获得最频繁的人名ID. 如果在事件冲突之前和之后有身份证明,我们就会将指派的人标记为混合身份。

blocks.en: A report can match a reference when person and direction agree, their times differ by at most 1 s, and their points are no farther apart than h g h_{g} , the person’s annotated box height at the reference frame. For each sequence and gate, we maximize the number of matched pairs and then minimize their total time difference.
blocks.zh: 当人和方向同意时,报告可以匹配一个引用,它们的时间差异最多为1秒,而且它们的点与h g h_{g}没有更远的距离,而h g h_{g},即指该人在引用框上的注解框高度. 对于每个序列和门,我们尽量增加匹配的对数,然后尽量减少它们的总时差.

blocks.en: Recall measures the fraction of reference crossings recovered: in visibility bin b b , it is K b / N b K_{b}/N_{b} , where N b N_{b} counts references and K b K_{b} counts matched ones. Precision measures the fraction of final reports that match the reference list: it is K / S K/S , where K K counts matched reports and S S counts all final reports, including those whose person assignment is unknown or mixed. Equally optimal assignments give identical bin counts when matching requires the same person (Supplement J.7).
blocks.zh: 回顾回收的参考过境点的一小部分:在可见度(bin b b)中,是K b / N b K _{ b}/ N _{ b},其中N b _{ b } b) 计数参考,K b _{ b) 计数对应参考。 精确度衡量与参考清单相符的最后报告的比例:K/S K/S, KK计算与报告相符,SS计算所有最后报告,包括人员分配不明或混合的报告。 同样最佳的指派在匹配时会给出相同的bin计数(补充J.7).

blocks.en: 3.4 Tracing a missed crossing
blocks.zh: 3.4 追查漏失的过境点

blocks.en: For each unmatched reference, GateTrace finds boxes linked to that person within ± \pm 25 frames by the box-level check. From tracks containing these boxes, it retrieves possible crossings and checking records at that gate, including crossings outside this window.
blocks.zh: 对于每个未匹配的引用, GateTrace 在 ±\pm 25 帧内通过框级检查找到与那个人相连的框 。 它从装有这些盒子的铁轨上取回可能经过的过境点和检查该大门的记录,包括这个窗口外的过境点。

blocks.en: GateTrace first searches for a final report for the same person and direction within the time and position limits. If none is found, it searches possible crossings that passed the depth check, then all possible crossings, under the same conditions. Those meeting these conditions but failing the depth check are recorded as rejected by that check.
blocks.zh: GateTrace在时间和位置限制内首先搜索同一人的最终报告及方向. 如果没有人,它就会在同样条件下搜查可能通过深度检查的过境点,然后搜查所有可能的过境点。 符合这些条件但未能进行深度检查的,记录为该检查拒绝。

blocks.en: If none meets these conditions, GateTrace checks the following cases in order and assigns the first that applies: 1. No nearby output box is linked to the person. 2. A possible crossing for the same person fails the direction, time or position conditions. 3. A possible crossing on a track containing boxes linked to the person meets those conditions, but its person assignment is not accepted for this reference. 4. A possible crossing fails to match for another reason. 5. Boxes linked to the person are present, but their tracks show no possible crossing at the gate.
blocks.zh: 如果没有人符合这些条件,GateTrace将检查下列情况,并指定适用的第一个情况: 1. 附近的输出框与个人没有关联。 2. 同一人可能的过境不符合指示、时间或位置条件。 3. 在载有与该人有关联的箱子的轨道上可能的过境符合这些条件,但不能接受其指定的人。 4. 可能的过境点由于另一个原因无法匹配。 5. 与该人有联系的盒子已经存在,但其行迹显示无法通过大门。

blocks.en: No nearby output box is linked to the person.
blocks.zh: 附近没有输出框与人物相连.

blocks.en: A possible crossing for the same person fails the direction, time or position conditions.
blocks.zh: 同一人可能的过境不符合指示、时间或位置条件。

blocks.en: A possible crossing on a track containing boxes linked to the person meets those conditions, but its person assignment is not accepted for this reference.
blocks.zh: 在载有与该人有关的盒子的轨道上可能的过境符合这些条件,但是其指定的人不被接受。

blocks.en: A possible crossing fails to match for another reason.
blocks.zh: 一个可能的过河由于另一个原因无法匹配.

blocks.en: Boxes linked to the person are present, but their tracks show no possible crossing at the gate.
blocks.zh: 与此人有联系的盒子已经存在,但其行迹显示在大门上不可能通过。

blocks.en: These records locate the step where a crossing was lost. Finding a possible crossing depends on the bottom-point rule, gate regions and gap reset. When a rule change adds reports, GateTrace records all additions, including unmatched reports and whether they correspond to annotated transitions outside the reference list.
blocks.zh: 这些记录确定了一个过境点丢失的台阶。 能否找到可能的过境点取决于底点规则、闸口区域和缺口的重置。 当规则更改添加报告时,GateTrace会记录所有添加,包括未匹配的报告,以及它们是否与参考列表以外的附加说明的过渡对应.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Data split. We develop the analysis on MOT20-01/02 (724 references; 180 low- and 210 high-visibility) and check its findings on MOT20-03/05 (3,948 references; 427 low- and 1,217 high-visibility). We call these the development and confirmation sets. After inspecting baseline results on 03/05, we fixed the confirmation protocol to constrain subsequent analysis choices.
blocks.zh: 数据分割. 我们对MOT20-01/02(724次参考;180次低可见度和210次高可见度)进行分析,并检查其对MOT20-03/05(3 948次参考;427次低可见度和1 217次高可见度)的调查结果。 我们称之为发展和确认的组合。 在2005年3月3日检查基准结果后,我们确定了确认协议,以限制随后的分析选择。

blocks.en: Systems. We compare ByteTrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] using the same detections. We export detections once per sequence from the official ByteTrack YOLOX-X checkpoint [ 3 , 19 ] (800 × \times 1440 input, score 0.01, NMS 0.7). Its documented training data include CrowdHuman [ 21 ] but exclude MOT20. We use the authors’ MOT17 tracking settings; BoT-SORT runs without ReID unless stated.
blocks.zh: 系统 我们用同样的探测器比较ByteTrack、OC-SORT和BOT-SORT[3、4、5]。 我们从官方的ByteTrack YOLOX-X检查点[3,19](800x\times 1440输入,得分0.01,NMS 0.7)输出每序列一次检测. 其记载的训练数据包括"人群人类"[21],但不包括MOT20. 我们使用作者的 MOT17 跟踪设置; 除非声明, BOT- SORT 不使用 ReID 运行 。

blocks.en: The tuned YOLOX composite admits detections at 0.10, runs ByteTrack at thresholds 0.25/0.10/0.25 and joins track fragments. BASE [ 6 ] supplies published tracks produced with MOT20-based parameter fitting, access to later frames and interpolation. The released files do not document their coordinate origin, so we report both one- and zero-based readings.
blocks.zh: 调制的YOLOX复合材料允许在0.10时检测,在阈值下运行字节跟踪 0.25/0.10/0.25和加入轨道碎片。 BASE [6] 供应使用基于 MOT20 的参数配置制成的已公布的音轨,访问后期帧和插值. 已发布文件不记录其坐标源,所以我们报告基于一和零的读数.

blocks.en: The annotation-box oracle supplies annotated boxes to the composite’s tracker and counting rules. The composite and oracle take their event points from the input detections associated with each track (Supplement B.2). Person matching always uses output boxes. We keep the model weights fixed. CrowdDet-based systems [ 20 ] appear in Supplements A and J.1; further variants appear in Supplement B.2.
blocks.zh: 注释框甲骨文为复合材料的跟踪和计数规则提供注释框。 复合体和甲骨文从每个音轨相关的输入检测中取出它们的事件点(补充B.2). 匹配人员总是使用输出框. 我们保持模型重量固定。 基于人群的Det系统 [20] 出现在补编中 A和J.1;其他备选案文见补编B.2。

blocks.en: Fixed confirmation protocol. Before running 03/05, we fixed two hypotheses for each sequence. H-A: each of these three trackers recovers at most 70% of low-visibility and at least 90% of high-visibility references. H-B: the composite recovers more low-visibility references than the best of these three trackers. Both must hold on both sequences. We later scored BASE’s published outputs for 03/05 against the same references as an additional analysis. This falls outside the fixed confirmation; BASE’s parameters were fitted on MOT20 training sequences that include these two.
blocks.zh: 固定确认协议。 在运行03/05之前,我们为每个序列确定了两个假设. H-A:这3个追踪器中每个都恢复了最多70%的低可见度和至少90%的高可见度参考. H-B:复合物比这三种跟踪器中最好的回收低可见度参考物. 两者必须坚持两条顺序。 我们后来将BASE在2005年3月公布的产出与补充分析的相同内容评分。 这不属于固定确认范围;BASE的参数被安装在MOT20培训序列上,其中包括这两个序列。

blocks.en: Human review. Two annotators watched videos for 88 development references, sampled by visibility (34 low-visibility, 18 in each other bin). They judged whether the person crossed, in which direction, whether the person on both sides was the same, and when the crossing happened. A reference is supported when both say the crossing occurred, identify the same person on both sides, and agree with the reference direction. They first answered separately, then discussed disagreements; we report both sets of judgments. During initial answering, one annotator consulted an AI assistant about definitions. Their discussion interface displayed AI reference answers (Supplement C).
blocks.zh: 人文评论. 两名注释员观看了88个发展参考的视频,以能见度为样本(34个低可见度,18个互在bin). 他们判断此人是否经过,朝哪个方向,双方的人是否相同,以及何时经过。 如果双方都说已经过境,确定双方的同一人,并同意参考方向,则支持引用。 他们首先分别回答,然后讨论了分歧;我们报告两套判决。 在初次答复期间,一名注释员就定义问题咨询了大赦国际的一名助理。 他们的讨论界面显示了AI的参考答案(补充C).

blocks.en: 5 Findings
blocks.zh: 5 调查结果

blocks.en: We measure missed crossings by visibility (Sec. 5.1), trace where they are lost (Sec. 5.2), and assess the recovery and precision cost of rule changes (Sec. 5.3). We then check human-supported crossings (Sec. 5.4) and compare frame metrics (Sec. 5.5).
blocks.zh: 我们通过能见度(第5.1条)、追踪丢失的过境点(第5.2条)以及评估规则变更的恢复和精确成本(第5.3条)。 然后检查人类支持的过境点(第5.4条),并比较框架指标(第5.5条)。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Development results (MOT20-01/02). Each visibility bin gives matched/total references. Precision is matched reports divided by all final reports. BASE values span the one- and zero-based coordinate readings.
blocks.zh: 表1:发展成果(MOT20-01/02)。 每个能见度框给出匹配/总计引用. 精确度与所有最后报告相匹配。 BASE值跨越了基于一和零的坐标读数.

blocks.en: 5.1 Crossing recovery drops sharply at low visibility
blocks.zh: 5.1 低能见度的交叉恢复急剧下降

blocks.en: Low-visibility crossings are often missed. On the development set the three trackers sharing a detector recover 70–84/180 low-visibility and 206–208/210 high-visibility crossings (Table 1 ). The tuned composite reaches 99/180 and BASE 114–115/180, while high-visibility recovery stays at 205–209/210 for all systems. Precision stays between 90.1% and 95.9% for all non-oracle systems. The gap remains in four systems under all nine tested combinations of matching tolerances (0.5–1.5 s and 0.5–1.5 body heights; Supplement B.3).
blocks.zh: 低可见度的过境点经常被错过。 在开发方面,三个追踪器共用一个探测器,70-84/180低可见度和206-208/210高可见度过境点(表1)。 调制的复合材料达到99/180和BASE 114-115/180,而所有系统的高可见度回收仍然保持在205-209/210。 所有非甲骨文系统的精度保持在90.1%至95.9%。 在所有9种测试的匹配耐受性组合下(0.5-1.5 s和0.5-1.5 车身高度;补充B.3)的4个系统中仍存在差距。

blocks.en: The same pattern appears on the confirmation sequences (Table 2 ). H-A holds for all three trackers sharing a detector on both sequences, and H-B holds with 67 vs. 57 low-visibility matches on 03 and 117 vs. 84 on 05. Combining 03/05, low-visibility recovery is 18.5–32.8% for these three trackers and 43.1% for the composite, against 92.7–96.6% for high-visibility crossings. In the additional analysis, BASE recovers 334–335/427 low-visibility and 1204–1208/1217 high-visibility crossings on 03/05, with a precision of 97.2%. BASE’s low-visibility recovery is 78.2–78.5%, still about 21 points below high visibility.
blocks.zh: 同样的模式出现在确认序列上(表2)。 H-A为在两个序列上共享一个探测器的所有3个跟踪者持有,H-B为在03和117对84的低能见度比赛中持有67对57对. 结合03/05,低可见度回收率是这3个跟踪器的18.5-32.8%,复合器的43.1%,而高可见度过境点的92.7-96.6%. 在补充分析中,BASE在03/05恢复了334–335/427低能见度和1204–1208/1217高能见度过境,精确度达到97.2%. BASE的低可见度回收率为78.2–78.5 %,仍低于高可见度的21点左右.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Confirmation results (MOT20-03/05), evaluated under the protocol fixed before execution. BASE was scored afterwards as an additional analysis; its values span the two coordinate readings.
blocks.zh: 表2:根据执行前确定的协议评估的确认结果(MOT20-03/05)。 BASE随后作为附加分析得分;其数值跨越两个坐标读数.

blocks.en: 5.2 Most BASE misses occur before later checks
blocks.zh: 5.2 大部分BASE缺失发生在以后检查之前

blocks.en: Most low-visibility BASE misses occur before later checks. Table 3 groups the saved records for missed references by the step where they stop. Its first row accounts for BASE’s 65–66 missed low-visibility crossings on the development sequences. For 20 crossings, no output box within ± \pm 1 s can be linked to the person by the box-level check. Missed detections, inaccurate boxes or ambiguous person assignments could each produce this state. For 23, boxes are linked to the person, but their tracks show no possible crossing at the gate. For 13, a possible crossing meets the matching conditions but fails the depth check. Final reports and crossings passing that check failed the matching conditions for these misses. Thus none was lost through competition in matching, merging events or checking positions before and after the event.
blocks.zh: 大多数低可见度的 BASE 缺失发生在以后检查之前 。 表3按停放时的顺序对已保存的失选引用记录进行分组。 它的第一排记录了BASE65–66在开发序列上忽略了低可见度的交叉. 对于20个交叉点,±\pm 1 s 内的输出框无法通过箱级检查与人连接. 检测失败、不准确的盒子或含糊不清的人任务,每个都可能产生这种状态。 23日,箱子与人相连,但他们的铁轨显示在大门上不可能通过. 13,可能的过关符合匹配条件,但深度检查失败. 最后报告和通过检查的过境点未能满足这些缺失的对应条件。 因此,在事件之前和之后的匹配、合并或检查位置方面没有出现竞争。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Where missed low-visibility crossings stop. The states defined in Sec. 3.4 are counted for four systems on the development (01/02) and confirmation (03/05) sequences. BASE entries give one-/zero-based readings where they differ. Nearby output means boxes linked to the person in the reference window. Other : a possible crossing passed the depth check but was removed by merging events or checking positions before and after them, or failed to match for another reason on a track containing these boxes. No missed crossing has a compatible final report.
blocks.zh: 表3: 错过低可见度过境站的地方。 第3.4节中定义的状态被计算在开发(01/02)和确认(03/05)序列的四个系统中。 BASE条目给出了基于1/0的读数,如果它们存在差异. 近输出是指在参考窗口中与人物连接的框. 其他:可能通过深度检查但通过合并事件或检查前后位置而删除,或者由于包含这些盒子的轨道上的另一个原因未能匹配. 没有漏掉的过境点有一份兼容的最后报告。

blocks.en: The mix of losses varies across systems. We examined the same records for the three trackers sharing a detector on both sequence groups and for BASE on 03/05 (Table 3 ). For 47–79% of low-visibility misses, we find no nearby box linked to the person or no possible crossing. Together, these states account for more than half in every case except BoT-SORT on the development sequences (45 of 96). The depth check rejects 11–27%. Another state is more common in ByteTrack and BoT-SORT: 16–22% of their misses have a possible crossing that meets the time and position conditions but is not accepted as belonging to the person. This accounts for 6–11% in BASE and 5–8% in OC-SORT.
blocks.zh: 损失的组合因系统而异。 我们审查了在两个序列组上共用探测器的3个跟踪器和03/05年BASE的相同记录(表3)。 对于47-79%的低能见度缺失,我们发现没有附近的盒子与这个人有关联,或者没有可能通过. 除关于开发序列的BOT-SORT(96年中的45个)外,这些状态加在一起在每一个案例中占一半以上。 深度检查拒绝 11–27% 。 另一种状态在ByteTrack和BOT-SORT中更为常见:16–22%的失事者可能有一个符合时间和位置条件但不被接受为属于个人的过境. 这在BASE占6-11%,在OC-SORT占5-8%。

blocks.en: Figure 3 traces the two BASE misses in Fig. 1 . A continuing track’s possible crossing fails the depth check: distance into the destination region divided by predicted body height is 0.194–0.199, below 0.2; using output box height gives 0.202–0.208. In the other case, 36 linked output boxes surround the reference, but the entire 72-frame track stays in the destination region without an internal gap. The counting rule finds no transition between regions for later checks to retain.
blocks.zh: 图3追踪了图1中两个BASE的缺失. 继续行驶的轨道可能跨越的深度检查失败:按预计车身高度划分的进入目的地区域的距离为0.194-0.199,低于0.2;使用输出箱高度为0.202-0.208。 在另一种情况下,36个链接输出框环绕了参考文献,但整个72帧轨道留在目的地区域,没有内部漏洞. 计票规则认为,各地区之间没有过渡,以后可以保留检查。

blocks.en: Two controls help interpret these misses (Supplement B.1). Supplying annotated boxes lets the composite recover nearly all low-visibility crossings. This changes observation availability and box geometry together and aligns crossing points with the references. Deleting half the annotated observations has a much larger effect when deletions are contiguous, reflecting both their timing and the reset of the last known region after a gap longer than 0.5 s.
blocks.zh: 两个控制有助于解释这些缺失(补充B.1)。 提供附加说明的箱,使复合体能够恢复几乎所有低可见度过境点。 这改变了观测可用性和框几何,使过境点与参考文献保持一致。 删除半数附加说明的观测值在删除时是毗连的,其效果要大得多,既反映了其时间,也反映了在超过0.5s的缺口后最后一个已知区域的重置.

blocks.en: 5.3 Changing later checks recovers few missed crossings
blocks.zh: 5.3 改变以后的检查,恢复很少错失的过境点

blocks.en: Filter changes add few low-visibility matches and lower precision. We hold BASE’s tracks and the original references fixed and remove the depth check, merging of events and checks of positions before and after them (Table 4 ). Matched low-visibility crossings rise from 114–115 to 127–128 of 180 and high-visibility recovery reaches 210/210; ByteTrack rises from 83 to 95. Against the same references, precision falls from 95.4–95.9% to 76.6–77.0% for BASE and from 90.1% to 65.9% for ByteTrack. The net gain of 13 counts changes in matches; the 13 depth-check rejections in Table 3 count misses under the original rules.
blocks.zh: 过滤器的修改增加了很少的低可见度匹配和较低的精度. 我们拥有BASE的轨迹和原始参考文献固定并删除深度检查、事件合并和前后位置检查(表4)。 相应的低可见度过境点从180个中的114-115个增加到127-128个,高可见度恢复到210-210个;字节道从83个增加到95个。 根据同样的参考,BASE的精度从95.4-95.9%下降到76.6-77.0%,ByteTrack的精度从90.1%下降到65.9%。 13项净收益计算匹配数变化;表3中的13项深度检查拒绝数没有按照原规则计算。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Changing the counting rules. Recall and precision use the same original development references in every row.
blocks.zh: 表4: 修改计票规则. 回忆和精确在每行使用相同的原始开发参考.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Two steps at which a crossing can be lost. (a) The person’s track stays entirely inside the destination region, so the counting rule finds no possible crossing. (b) A possible crossing is found but fails the depth check. Geometry is schematic; both cases come from the saved BASE records.
blocks.zh: 图3:可以丢失过境点的两个步骤。 (a) 此人的行迹完全停留在目的地地区,因此计票规则无法通过。 (b) 发现可能的过境点,但未进行深度检查。 几何是图案;这两个案例都来自保存的BASE记录.

blocks.en: We also tested a selective change: keeping BASE’s possible crossings rejected by the depth check when the YOLOX composite supports them. It adds five to six low-visibility matches and loses none, but also adds 9–11 unmatched reports, most of which coincide with annotated transitions outside the original reference list. We designed this exploratory repair after inspecting development failures. Its acceptance rule, recorded before the run, required no precision loss, so we do not adopt it. With these outputs and rules for finding possible crossings fixed, most low-visibility misses occur before the later filters: even without these filters, 52–53 of 180 remain unmatched for BASE and 85 for ByteTrack.
blocks.zh: 我们还测试了一种选择性的改变:在YOLOX复合材料支持时,将BASE可能的过境点保留在深度检查中。 它增加了5至6个低能见度匹配,没有损失,但也增加了9至11个不匹配的报告,其中大部分与原参考清单以外的附加说明的过渡相吻合. 我们在检查开发故障后设计了这次探索性修复. 它的接受规则,在运行前记录,不需要精确损失,所以我们不采用它. 随着这些产出和寻找可能的过境点的规则固定下来,在以后的过滤器之前就出现了大多数低可见度的缺失:即使没有这些过滤器,180个过滤器中的52-53个仍然无法与BASE和85个ByteTrack匹配。

blocks.en: The reference rule affects which reports match. Some unmatched reports correspond to annotated transitions excluded from the original reference list. Keeping reports from the relaxed rules fixed and adding these transitions to the reference list gives 147–151 additional matches for BASE and 121 for ByteTrack, with precision 93.5–94.4% and 78.9% (Supplements G and J.5). These scores measure agreement with the expanded list of annotated transitions, whose physical occurrence requires separate evidence. Against the original list, the relaxed reports retain the lower precision reported above.
blocks.zh: 参考规则影响哪些报告相符。 一些未匹配的报告与原参考清单中不包括的附加说明的过渡对应。 将放松规则的报告固定下来,并将这些过渡列入参考清单,使BASE和ByteTrack的匹配率分别为147-151和121,精确度分别为93.5-94.4%和78.9%(补充G和J.5)。 这些分数衡量与附加说明的过渡扩大清单的协议,其实际发生需要单独的证据. 对照原始清单,放宽的报告保持了上述较低的精确度。

blocks.en: 5.4 Misses remain among crossings supported by human review
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 在人类审查的支持下,小姐仍留在过境点

blocks.en: Human review supports crossings that systems still miss. Both annotators initially supported 64 of 88 sampled references, including 18 of 34 low-visibility ones. After discussing disagreements, these counts were 79 and 25. Within the supported subsets, every system misses more low- than high-visibility crossings (Table 5 ); for ByteTrack the initial counts are 8 of 18 against 0 of 18.
blocks.zh: 人文审查支持各种系统仍然漏掉的过境点。 两个注释员最初都支持88个抽样参考文献中的64个,包括34个低可见度参考文献中的18个. 在讨论分歧之后,这些罪名是79和25。 在所支持的子集中,每个系统都错过了比高可见度高的过境点(表5);对于ByteTrack来说,最初的计数是18比0比8。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Misses among crossings supported by both annotators. Each cell gives unmatched/supported references within the sample, without weighting.
blocks.zh: 表5: 由两位注释员支助的过境点中的失职情况。 每个单元格在样本中给出无比/支持的引用,而不进行加权.

blocks.en: Timing is less certain. Of 14 sampled references for which both annotators gave a time interval, 13 intervals overlap. Only five pairs both contain the reference frame, and only one of those is low-visibility.
blocks.zh: 时机不太确定。 在14个抽样参考文献中,有13个间隔,两个注释者都给出了时间间隔。 只有五对都包含参考框架,其中只有一个是低可见度.

blocks.en: 5.5 Relation to frame-level metrics
blocks.zh: 5.5 与帧度量衡的关系

blocks.en: Crossing recall measures omissions as missed passages. Frame metrics also decline at low visibility. Only 3 of 56 confirmation-set comparisons give opposite tracker rankings by frame metrics and crossing recall, with differences meeting our thresholds: on MOT20-05, BoT-SORT scores higher on the frame metrics, but ByteTrack recovers five more low-visibility crossings (Supplement J.7).
blocks.zh: 交叉召回作为漏掉的段落衡量遗漏。 框架衡量标准也低能见度下降。 在56个确认套数比较中,只有3个给出了按帧度量和跨度量的相反的跟踪器排名,其差异达到了我们的阈值:在MOT20-05上,BOT-SORT在帧度量量量量上得分较高,但ByteTrack恢复了另外5个低可见度的交叉(补充J.7).

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: The study covers four MOT20 sequences from a small number of scene conditions, with many dependent crossings in each scene. Three trackers share one detector; BASE uses published outputs with a different training and processing history and an undocumented coordinate origin. Reference points lie at the bottom of full-body annotation boxes and may be hidden behind occluders. Human judgments support the crossing, its direction and the same person on both sides in a sample drawn by visibility, but rarely exact timing. The saved records locate losses within the counting procedure. Several causes can produce the same recorded state: a late or broken track and differences between output and annotated box bottoms can each prevent the counting rule from finding a crossing. The tested repair and retrospective repair-selection check both failed their acceptance criteria (Supplement G).
blocks.zh: 该研究涵盖从少量场景条件出发的4个MOT20序列,每个场景有许多依赖性的交叉. 三个追踪器共用一个探测器;BASE使用已公布的输出,具有不同的训练和处理历史以及无证坐标源. 参考点位于全身注解框的底部,可能隐藏在占卜器后面. 人类的判断支持过境点、其方向和双方的同一人,以能见度为样本,但很少准确的时间。 保存的记录在计数程序内查找损失。 有几个原因可以产生相同的记录状态:一个迟到或断裂的音轨,输出和注释框底的差异,可以阻止计数规则找到过关. 经测试的修理和追溯性修理选择检查都未能达到其接受标准(补充G)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: GateTrace uses annotated trajectories, gate geometry, tracker outputs and saved counting records to match crossings to reports and trace omissions hidden by total counts. Across four MOT20 sequences, three trackers sharing one detector miss over half of low-visibility crossings; published outputs of MOT20-tuned BASE miss a fifth to over a third of these crossings across both sequence groups. Human video review also supports some crossings that remain unmatched. The mix of low-visibility losses differs across four systems, but the largest share lacks nearby output linked to the person or a possible crossing; fewer fail the depth check. Later checks process only crossings already found. Removing them on development data adds few low-visibility matches for BASE and ByteTrack and lowers precision against fixed references. For tracking-based crowd-flow monitoring, GateTrace supports offline evaluation that reports crossing recall by visibility and inspects individual misses alongside frame metrics.
blocks.zh: GateTrace使用附加注释的轨迹,闸门几何,跟踪器输出和保存的计数记录来匹配过关与报告,并跟踪全部计数隐藏的遗漏. 在四个MOT20序列中,共用一个探测器的3个跟踪器错过了一半的低可见度过境点;MOT20调制的BASE的公布产出错过了其中五分之一至三分之一以上跨越两个序列组的过境点。 人气视频审查也支持一些仍然无法匹配的过路. 低能见度损失的组合在四个系统中有所不同,但最大的份额缺乏与个人相连的邻近产出或可能的过关;更少的失败深度检查. 之后的检查程序只发现过境点。 在开发数据中去除它们,增加了很少BASE和ByteTrack的低可见度匹配,比固定引用的精确度更低. 对于基于跟踪的人群流动监测,GateTrace支持线下评价,即报告通过能见度进行召回,并检查个人与帧度量衡缺失。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The stadium recordings were obtained from a prior IRB-approved study and shared with the authors with permission for their use in this research. Only aggregate stadium results are reported, and the recordings are excluded from the released resource. The two annotators are authors and agreed to the use of their judgments in this study. The main evaluation uses MOT20 under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, and derived labels retain the required attribution.
blocks.zh: 体育场的录音是从移民和难民局先前批准的一项研究中获得的,经允许与提交人分享,供他们在这项研究中使用。 只有体育场的汇总结果被报告,录音从释放的资源中排除. 两位注释员是作者,同意在本研究报告中使用他们的判决。 主要评价在CC BY-NC-SA 3.0下使用MOT20,衍生标签保留了所要求的归属.

blocks.en: LLM Usage Statement
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 用法声明

blocks.en: Claude (Anthropic) and OpenAI Codex (called Astra in Supplement D) were used to retrieve and check literature, generate related-work material, generate and rewrite passages from author-provided text and ideas, propose interpretations and analysis plans, implement and run analyses and numerical checks, and produce figures through generated plotting code. Some assigned literature-search, coding and analysis tasks involved multiple steps completed by the tools before author review. The authors reviewed these outputs and checked the final analyses, figures, claims and text. Codex and a locally run Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct generated visual answers for the auxiliary comparison in Supplement D. During initial answering, one of the two annotators consulted Codex on task interpretation and examples; joint reconciliation displayed Codex and Qwen answers for consultation. Initial and reconciled human records are reported separately. AI visual answers were not used as reference labels or inputs to event matching. Human-support and human–human agreement statistics were derived from the recorded human responses under these assistance conditions. Numerical recomputations checked the reported statistics using shared upstream records and components (Supplement I). The authors take responsibility for the reported work.
blocks.zh: Claude(Anthropic)和OpenAI Codex(称为Astra in Supplement D)被用来检索和检查文献,生成相关的工作材料,生成和改写作者提供的文本和想法的段落,提出解释和分析计划,实施和运行分析和数字检查,并通过生成的绘图代码生成数字. 一些指定的文献搜索、编码和分析任务涉及工具在作者审查前完成的多个步骤。 提交人审查了这些产出,并检查了最后分析、数字、申诉和案文。 Codex和本地运行的Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为补充D中的辅助比较生成了视觉解答. 在初始解答期间,两位注释员之一就任务解释和实例咨询了Codex;联合解析显示Codex和Quen解答以征求意见. 初步和核对过的人类记录另行报告。 AI视觉解答没有用作事件匹配的参考标签或输入. 人类支持和人与人之间的协议统计来源于在这些援助条件下记录下来的人类反应。 数字重算利用共享的上游记录和组成部分(补编一)核对了报告的统计数据。 提交人对所报告的工作负责。

blocks.en: Appendix A. Complete confirmation results
blocks.zh: 附录A. 完整确认结果

blocks.en: For H-A, the three low-visibility matched counts on 03 are 56,37,57 out of N=136; their high-visibility counts are 548,532,547 out of N=572. On 05 the corresponding counts are 84,42,79 out of N=291 and 610,596,611 out of N=645. Each satisfies the inequalities in main-paper Section 4; Appendix J.2 gives their exact integer form. H-B holds because 67>57 and 117>84. The CrowdDet comparison is also retained: P2 and the composite recover 43 versus 43 low-visibility events on 03, and 39 versus 36 on 05. Combining M3/M4 therefore gave no low-visibility gain in this confirmation comparison.
blocks.zh: 对于H-A,03的三种低可见度匹配计数为56,37,57N=136;其高可见度计数为548,532,547N=572. 05年,相应的计数是84 42 79 N=291,610 596 611 N=645。 每一文件都满足了主要文件第4节中的不平等;附录J.2给出了确切的整数形式。 H-B持有因为67>57和117>84. 还保留了CrowdDet比较:P2和复合恢复了03年43对43次低可见事件,05年39对36对. 因此,将M3/M4合并,在这种确认比较中不会产生低可见度收益。

blocks.en: Appendix B. Controls, sensitivity, and uncertainty
blocks.zh: 附录B. 控制、敏感性和不确定性

blocks.en: B.1. Attribution and controlled deletion
blocks.zh: B.1. 归属和有控制的删除

blocks.en: Two controls help interpret these misses. When given annotated boxes, the composite’s tracker and the same counting rules recover 173/180 low-visibility development crossings and 412/427 on the confirmation set. This oracle changes both the available observations and box geometry, and its crossing points coincide with the references. It shows that the counting rules can recover nearly all low-visibility crossings from this input, while leaving the contributions of these factors unresolved. A second control deletes half of each person’s annotated observations. Overall crossing recall is 89.6% when deletions are dispersed and 22.4–22.5% when they are contiguous. This difference reflects both the timing of the missing observations and the rule that resets region history after a gap longer than 0.5 s.
blocks.zh: 两个控件帮助解释这些缺失 。 当给标注的箱子时,复合材料的跟踪器和同样的计票规则收回173/180低可见度发展过境点和确认装置上的412/427。 这一征兆既改变了现有的观察,也改变了框几何,其过境点与参考文献相吻合。 这表明,计票规则可以从这种输入中收回几乎所有低可见度的过境点,而这些因素的促成因素却得不到解决。 第二种控制可以删除每个人附加注释的观察的一半。 在删除时,总的过境召回率为89.6%,在相邻时为22.4-22.5%。 这种差异既反映了缺失观测的时间,也反映了在间隔超过0.5秒后重现区域历史的规则.

blocks.en: Rounding within each segment makes the retained fraction differ from the requested value. Both deletion patterns remove the same number of observations from each segment. No predictive formula was fixed in advance for these descriptive curves. Their values reflect both tracking behavior and the reset in the counting rules after a gap longer than 0.5 s.
blocks.zh: 在每一段内进行四舍五入,使保留部分与所要求的数值不同。 两种删除模式都从每个片段中去除相同数量的观测. 这些描述曲线没有预先确定预测公式。 他们的值既反映了跟踪行为,也反映了在超过0.5 s的空隙后在计数规则中的重置.

blocks.en: B.2. Tested interventions and component comparisons
blocks.zh: B.2. 经测试的干预措施和组成部分比较

blocks.en: HeadGate uses head annotations from the same MOT20-01 video; Sundararaman et al. [22] describe their dense-head benchmark source. The relinking test keeps the saved observations and the specified gap and interpolation procedure fixed. The component comparisons change several parts of the processing chain. The full composite gains 13 events over the author-threshold variant and two over the variant without M4. These differences describe the tested configurations; they cannot allocate all missed crossings additively to individual components.
blocks.zh: HeadGate使用同一MOT20-01视频的头条注解;Sundararaman等人. [22] 描述它们的密集头基准源. 重联测试使保存的观测以及指定的缺口和插值程序得以固定. 组件比较会改变处理链的几个部分. 完整的复合增益 作者-阈值变量的13个事件,以及没有M4的变量的2个事件. 这些差异描述了经过测试的配置;它们不能将所有错失的交叉添加到单个组件中.

blocks.en: B.3. Existing descriptive robustness analyses
blocks.zh: B.3. 现有描述性强性分析

blocks.en: The saved tolerance checks cover four systems at nine time/distance combinations. Nominal time thresholds of 0.5,1.0,1.5 s correspond to 12,25,37 frame ticks at 25 fps; spatial thresholds are 0.5,1.0,1.5 reference heights. The low/high visibility gap remains across the reported 144 rows. Increasing the event-matching time tolerance from 1.0 to 1.5 s adds at most three low-visibility matches. We also checked visibility defined by the minimum over ± \pm 25 frames, the mean over ± \pm 12, or the value at the reference frame. The gap remains when the pooled samples are divided into density thirds. The source analysis records ties and undefined values in very small groups.
blocks.zh: 节省的耐受性检查涵盖四个系统,共9次/距离组合. 名义时间阈值为0.5,1.0,1.5s,相当于25 fps时的12,25,37帧勾;空间阈值为0.5,1.0,1.5参考高度. 在报告的144行中,低/高可见度差距仍然存在。 将事件比对时间容忍度从1.0s提高到1.5s,最多增加了三个低可见度匹配. 我们还检查了最小值大于 ±\pm 25 帧、平均值大于 ±\pm 12 帧的可见度或参考框架的值。 当集合样品分为密度的三分之一时,差距依然存在。 源分析在极小的群体中记录了联系和未定义的值.

blocks.en: Selecting the best of the three trackers sharing detections separately on each sequence gives 57+84=141 low-visibility matches in total. ByteTrack gives 56+84=140. These are separate comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在每个序列上分别选择共享检测的3个追踪器中的最佳选择,总共给出57+84=141低可见度匹配. 字节跟踪给出56+84=140. 这些都是单独的比较。

blocks.en: Appendix C. Human judgments and reference support
blocks.zh: 附录C. 人类判决和参考支持

blocks.en: The initially supported low-visibility subset contains three events from MOT20-01 and fifteen from MOT20-02, involving eighteen distinct people. After joint review, these counts are five and twenty, involving twenty-five distinct people. The eighteen supported high-visibility events involve sixteen people. Events can still depend on one another through shared scenes and processing. These counts describe the sampled references; unequal sampling fractions, Q2 exclusion, and unresolved cases limit conclusions about the full population.
blocks.zh: 最初支持的低能见度子集包含MOT20-01和MOT20-02的15个事件,涉及18个不同的人. 经过联合审查,这些罪名分为5项和20项,涉及25个不同的人。 这18项支持的高知名度活动涉及16人。 事件仍然可以通过分享场景和处理来互相依赖. 这些统计描述了抽样参考;不平等的抽样分数、问题2排除和未解决的案件限制了对全部人口的结论。

blocks.en: BASE recovered the single low-visibility item for which both intervals contain the reference frame. The intervals span 1.36 and 3.40 seconds, so they do not validate timing at the ± \pm 1-second matching tolerance. Excluding supported items whose intervals explicitly conflict with the reference leaves initial low-visibility misses of 2/16 for BASE and 1/16 for the repair. These subsets still contain items with missing intervals. The human judgments support the reported subsets for occurrence, person and direction, with reference times and matching tolerances held fixed. Reference accuracy across the full population and BASE’s miss rate on crossings with validated timing remain unresolved.
blocks.zh: BASE回收了单个低可见度项目,两个间隔都包含参考框架. 间隔跨度为1.36秒和3.40秒,因此它们不会在±\pm 1秒匹配容限时验证计时. 不包括间隔明显与参考不一致的辅助项目,因为最初低可见度差,BASE为2/16,修理为1/16。 这些子集仍然包含间隔缺失的项目. 人类的判断支持所报告的子集的发生、人物和方向,并规定了参考时间和匹配的容忍度。 整个人口的参考准确度和经核实的过境时间差率仍未解决。

blocks.en: For each sequence, ordinary least squares fits body height h from box-center x-coordinate x_c and top y-coordinate y 0 :
blocks.zh: 对于每个序列,普通最小的方格符合从箱-中心x坐标x_c和顶部y坐标y0的车身高度h:

blocks.en: The second expression predicts height at a bottom point (x,y). We fit it using evaluated pedestrian boxes strictly inside all four image boundaries, without a visibility threshold. Horizontal gates lie at 0.30H, 0.50H, and 0.70H, spanning 0.02W to 0.98W. Vertical gates lie at 0.25W, 0.50W, and 0.75W, spanning 0.02H to 0.98H. At midpoint height h_m, the adjacent rectangular regions have gap half-width 0.05h_m and depth h_m. IN denotes movement from the upper or left region to the other; OUT denotes the reverse.
blocks.zh: 第二个表达式预测一个底点的高度(x,y). 我们使用评估的行人箱 严格地在四个图像边界之内 而没有可见度阈值 水平门位于0.30H,0.50H,0.70H,跨度为0.02W至0.98W. 垂直门位于0.25W,0.50W,0.75W,跨度为0.02H至0.98H. 在中高h_m,相邻的长方形区域有半宽0.05h_m和深度h_m的差距. IN表示从上部或左部区域向另一部区域移动;Out表示相反。

blocks.en: A valid point entering the region opposite its last assigned region creates a transition. Points outside both rectangles leave the remembered region unchanged. An absence of track observations longer than 0.5 s resets the fragment. The entry frame and position come from an observed point, without interpolation. To decide whether a reference meets the depth rule, we search the person’s available rows from entry through 50 frames later, inclusive. A point in the destination region meets that rule when its Euclidean distance from the finite gate-facing edge reaches 0.2 times that row’s annotated height. This search is not restricted to the same fragment. The timestamp is the observed entry into the opposite region across the gap around the central line.
blocks.zh: 在最后一个指定区域对面进入该区域的一个有效点将产生过渡。 这两个矩外的点使记忆所在的区域保持不变。 没有超过0.5的轨迹观测使碎片重新出现。 输入框和位置来自一个观测点,没有内插. 为了决定一个引用是否符合深度规则,我们从输入到50帧,包括以后的搜索。 当欧几利得与有限大门边缘的距离达到0. 这种搜索并不限于同一片段。 时间戳是观察到的穿过中心线周围的缺口进入相反的区域.

blocks.en: Height fitting requires at least three eligible rows, matrix rank three, and finite coefficients. Inverting the geometry requires a finite nonzero denominator and a positive midpoint height. For system C1, a nonpositive or nonfinite denominator or height makes normalized depth unavailable. Extrapolated values are flagged and retained without clipping. The reference depth rule adds a pixel tolerance of 10 - 9 to the edge distance before comparing it with 0.2 times annotated height; the system depth check applies its tolerance to normalized depth. We attribute no numerical effect to this tolerance difference. An invalid event point leaves the remembered region unchanged but updates the observation time. Event points exclude side and lower boundaries; height fitting also excludes the upper boundary.
blocks.zh: 高度适配要求至少3行合格,矩阵排行3,以及有限系数. 反转几何需要一个有限的非零分母和正中点高度. 对于系统C1来说,非阳性或非无限分母或高度使得无法正常的深度. 外推值标出并保留,不进行剪切. 参考深度规则在边缘距离上添加了10-9的像素耐受性,然后将其与0.2倍注解高度比较;系统深度检查应用其耐受性来规范深度. 我们不认为这种容忍差异具有数值效应。 一个无效的事件点会让记忆中的区域保持不变,但会更新观测时间. 事件点排除了侧线和下线;高度配置也排除了上线.

blocks.en: The reference rule affects which reports match. Some unmatched reports may correspond to annotated transitions excluded by the reference depth rule. S has 901 references: 90 on 01 and 811 on 02, including 239 low-visibility and 244 high-visibility references. We keep the geometry, bottom-point rules, invalid boundaries and 0.5-second gap rule. Both the system’s possible crossings and the reference crossings included in the comparison change; the person, time and distance matching conditions stay fixed.
blocks.zh: 固定轨道比较使用原始定义O,参考文献由深度规则和最终事件保留,对称定义S,在两侧过滤前进行过渡. S有901个参考文献:01有90个,02有811个,包括239个低可见度和244个高可见度参考文献. 我们保留几何,底点规则,无效边界和0.5秒间隙规则. 该系统可能的过境点和比较中包括的参考过境点;人员、时间和距离匹配条件保持不变。

blocks.en: Added low-visibility reference matches that persist under both BASE coordinate interpretations number zero on 01 and twelve on 02; ByteTrack adds three and nine. Each of the four system–sequence comparisons had to give at least max(2,ceil(0.05 N_low)) stable additions involving at least two people: two additions on 01 and eight on 02. Three comparisons pass, while BASE/01 fails. We therefore stop before expanding human review. This threshold decides whether to spend resources on further review; it is separate from a statistical significance test.
blocks.zh: 添加低可见度参考比对,在BASE坐标解释编号01为0,02为12;ByteTrack增加了3和9. 4个系统中的每个系统-序列比较必须至少给出最大(2,ceil(0.05 N_low))的稳定添加,至少涉及2人:01年2人,02年8人。 三次比较通过,而BASE/01失败. 因此,在扩大人类审查之前,我们先停止。 这一门槛值决定是否将资源花在进一步审查上;它与统计意义测试分开。

blocks.en: Scoring the original-reference subset separately and extracting it from full S matching give the same reference memberships in this run. On that subset, BASE matches 127–128/180 low-visibility references and ByteTrack 95/180. The corresponding high-visibility counts are BASE 210/210 and ByteTrack 208/210. Thus the visibility gap remains after removing C1/R1/R2 while keeping the original geometry, person-ID checks, references, and tolerances. Independent recomputation agreed on these high-visibility counts. Across the full S reference set, BASE matches 166–169/239 and ByteTrack 124/239. Main-paper Section 5.3 and Appendix J.5 report precision ranges across the two coordinate interpretations. Seventeen previously unmatched BASE final reports in each interpretation and 21 ByteTrack reports match newly included references. These reports were already present; they differ from the 11/9 unmatched reports added by the earlier BASE repair.
blocks.zh: 分别对原参考子集进行校验,并从全S配对中提取,在此运行中给出了相同的参考成员. 在该子集上,BASE匹配127-128/180低可见度参考和ByteTrack 95/180. 相应的高可见度计数为BASE 210/210和ByteTrack 208/210. 因此,在删除C1/R1/R2同时保留原始几何、人身份检查、参考和容忍度之后,可见度差距依然存在。 独立重算同意这些高可见度计数. 在整个S参考集中,BASE匹配166–169/239和ByteTrack124/239. 主体文件第5.3节和附录J.5报告的精确度介于两个协调解释之间。 每种口译中17份以前没有对应的BASE最后报告和21份字节跟踪报告与新列入的参考资料相符。 这些报告已经提交;它们与早先的BASE修复工作补充的11/9号报告不同。

blocks.en: A separate check compares four repair options using existing caches from all four previously analyzed sequences. The baseline A0 for this check uses index-corrected ByteTrack at high/low/new thresholds 0.6/0.1/0.7, no external M3 or M4, and event points from the original detection boxes associated with each track. A1 changes admission and tracking thresholds to the low-score settings without M4. A2 adds M4 to A0. A3 changes A0’s event points to the bottom centers of tracker output boxes. Geometry, event rules and scoring stay fixed. This retrospective comparison has its own baseline and leaves the main-paper system rows unchanged.
blocks.zh: 使用之前分析过的所有四个序列中现有的缓存,单独检查比较了四个修复选项. 本检查的基准A0使用高/低/新阈值0.6/0.1/0.7的指数校正字节,没有外部的M3或M4,以及每个音轨相关的原始检测框的事件点. A1在没有M4. A2的低分数设置中更改了录取和跟踪阈值,将M4加到A0. A3 变化 A0事件指向跟踪器输出框的底层中心。 几何,事件规则和积分固定。 这种追溯比较有自己的基线,主纸系统行不变.

blocks.en: We accept an action’s positive low-visibility gain only if the high-visibility count and precision do not decrease. Precision is computed with matching that requires the correct person. Otherwise we retain A0 and assign zero utility. O chooses the highest accepted utility for each sequence, then averages the four sequence rates equally. C* recommends the same action for every sequence, subject to the same acceptance rule and fallback. Fixed recommendation A1 achieves the same accepted utility as selecting separately by sequence: it is adopted on 01/03/05, with fallback to A0 on 02. Thus O − - C*=0, below the required one-percentage-point advantage for selection. We stop this check without a human selection experiment. A separate implementation reproduced the event person-ID votes, allowed matching pairs, and acceptance and fallback arithmetic from the saved upstream records, using the same assignment solver.
blocks.zh: 我们接受行动的积极低能见度收益,除非高能见度和精确度不降低。 精度通过匹配来计算,这需要正确的人. 否则我们保留A0,并指定零功用. O为每个序列选择最高接受的效用,然后平均四个序列率相等. C*建议对每一序列采取相同的行动,但需遵守相同的接受规则并退后。 固定建议A1实现了与按顺序单独选择相同的公认效用:它于2005年3月1日获得通过,02日倒置为A0. 因此,O-C*=0低于所需1个百分点的评选优势。 我们停止了这种检查 没有人类选择实验。 一个单独的执行复制了事件个人ID的投票,允许匹配对数,并使用同一任务解析器从保存的上游记录中接受和倒数算术.

blocks.en: The definition comparison was independently recomputed. An additional implementation reproduced the repair-selection analysis from saved records. Appendix I describes both checks.
blocks.zh: 定义的比较是独立的。 另有一项执行从保存的记录中转载了修复选择分析。 附录一介绍了这两笔支票。

blocks.en: Appendix H. Details of the counting rules
blocks.zh: 附录H. 计票规则的细节

blocks.en: R1 groups events that passed C1 and have the same track and direction. Successive events may be at most two seconds apart, so a group can span more than two seconds. R2 checks the intervals [earliest − - 1,earliest) and (latest,latest+1] in seconds. It counts only valid observations assigned to either region. If either interval has fewer than three such points, it keeps the group and flags insufficient evidence without checking the proportions in the required regions. Otherwise both required proportions must reach 0.5.
blocks.zh: R1分组事件通过C1,并具有相同的轨道和方向. 连续的事件可能相距最多2秒,因此一个组可以跨过2秒以上. R2在秒内检查间隔[最远−-1,最远]和(最晚,最晚+1). 它只计算分配给两个区域的有效观察。 如果两者的间隔都少于3个,则在不检查所需区域的比例的情况下,小组和标记证据不足。 否则,这两项要求的比例必须达到0.5。

blocks.en: For person-ID voting, we use frames strictly before the system event on the earlier side and frames at or after it on the later side. Both are restricted to the complete ± \pm 25-frame window. A person-ID can be assigned from the combined window even when one side has insufficient evidence. If both sides receive different person-IDs, their disagreement takes precedence over the combined assignment. The proportions of observations in each region and the person-ID assigned on each side are recorded separately.
blocks.zh: 对于个人ID投票,我们严格地在系统事件之前使用帧,在后方使用帧。 两者都限于完整的±\pm 25帧窗口. 即使在一方证据不足的情况下,也可以从合并窗口中指定人身份。 如果双方接受不同的个人身份证明,他们的不同意见优先于合并转让。 每一区域的观测比例和每一方指定的人名标识分别记录。

blocks.en: The three height values serve different steps. The reference depth rule uses the annotated height of each supporting box. System C1 uses the height predicted by the fitted model. Final matching uses the annotated height at the reference event frame. Invalid image points, missing information for the person-ID check, and uncertainty are retained at the stages where they occur.
blocks.zh: 三个高度值服务于不同的步骤. 引用深度规则使用每个支持框的注解高度. C1系统采用安装型号预测的高度. 最终匹配使用引用事件框架的注释高度. 无效的图像点, 缺少用于人物ID检查的信息, 和不确定性在其发生的阶段被保留.

blocks.en: Appendix I. Reproducing calculations from saved records
blocks.zh: 附录一. 从保存的记录中复制计算

blocks.en: The checks distinguish saved inputs, the calculations made from them, and whether a passage physically occurred. Claude (Anthropic) generated and ran a separate implementation (see the LLM Usage Statement) to recompute the BASE scores, repair counts, missed-crossing stages, and symmetric-definition results. Its results matched on 8 November 2026. These implementations share the exact matcher and some person-ID logic with the original pipeline. They reuse the original-definition final events, decisions about whether the depth requirement was met, and some reference attributes from saved records. The checkers could see the target results. Earlier recomputation records cover results for the three trackers sharing saved detections and the confirmation results. On 9 November 2026 the same assistant recomputed Appendix K with a separate implementation of output parsing, assigning person-IDs to boxes and events, matching and stage assignment, while reusing saved counting-rule records. Every bin count, all 7,896 per-reference match states for BASE on 03/05 and all 4,321 per-reference stages behind Table K2 (all visibility bins) agree with the original outputs.
blocks.zh: 检查区分了所保存的投入、所作的计算以及是否实际发生了通过。 Claude (Anthropic) 生成并运行了单独的执行(参见LLM Usage语句),以重新计算BASE的分数,修复计数,错过阶段,以及对称定义的结果. 其结果与2026年11月8日相符。 这些执行与原始管道共享精确的匹配器和一些人身份逻辑. 它们重新使用原始定义的最后事件,决定是否满足深度要求,以及保存记录中的一些参考属性。 检查者可以看到目标结果. 早期的重算记录涵盖了三个追踪器共享节省的检测结果和确认结果. 2026年11月9日,同一助手重编附录K,单独执行输出解析,将人物ID分配到箱和事件,匹配和舞台分配,同时重用保存的计数规则记录. 每个本位计数,每个参考的7,896个都与03/05年BASE的状态相匹配,表K2(所有可见度bins)后面所有4,321个参考阶段都与原始输出一致.

blocks.en: A separate code audit generated and run with OpenAI Codex (see the LLM Usage Statement) rebuilt human-support classifications, time-interval transformations, versioned agreement counts, and their links to full-sequence matches from saved answers and mappings. A separate aggregation rebuilt every human-AI agreement fraction from the individual saved responses. Another implementation rebuilt event person-IDs, allowed matching pairs, all-bin scores, and adoption and fallback calculations for the emitted-box variant and the repair options. It reused the exact assignment solver, saved event extraction, and assignments linking output boxes in each frame to reference people. Figure values and geometry were checked against the corresponding reproduced records. Input hashes, per-item comparisons, and execution records are archived with these checks.
blocks.zh: 与OpenAI Codex(参见LLM Usage语句)单独生成并运行的代码审核重建了人类支持分类,时际转换,版本协议计数,以及它们与保存的答案和映射中全序列匹配的链接. 单独汇总后重建了个人所保存的响应中的每一部分人类-AI协议. 另一项执行重建了事件人名ID,允许匹配对数,全斌分数,以及采用和倒置计算所释放的框变体和修复选项。 它重新使用精确的任务解析器,保存事件提取,以及将每个帧中的输出框与参考人连接起来的任务. 对照相应的复制记录,对图值和几何进行了核对。 输入散列、逐项比较和执行记录与这些检查一起存档。

blocks.en: The BASE repair is an exploratory engineering study designed after inspecting development failures. Its acceptance rule was recorded with a hash when execution started, before scores were computed; the protocol also calls the study exploratory. The precision decrease causes it to fail the no-precision-loss condition.
blocks.zh: BASE修复是在检查开发故障后设计的探索性工程研究. 其接受规则在开始执行时,在计算分数之前用散列记录;协议也称研究探索. 精度下降导致它未能达到无精度损失状况.

blocks.en: One archived one-based BASE repair run is marked as failed because a console print error occurred after its outputs had been written; these outputs reproduce the reported repair row. The coordinate origin of the published BASE tracks remains unresolved, so both coordinate interpretations are reported.
blocks.zh: 一个存档的基于 BASE 的修复运行被标记为失败,因为一个控制台打印错误发生在其输出被写入之后;这些输出复制了所报告的修复行. 已公布的BASE音轨的坐标来源仍未解决,因此两条坐标解释都有报道.

blocks.en: These checks reproduce the reported calculations from saved inputs. Independent validation of the human judgments and a fully independent end-to-end replication of event extraction and matching remain outstanding.
blocks.zh: 这些检查复制了所保存输入中报告的计算. 人类判断的独立验证和完全独立的端到端复制事件提取和匹配仍有待完成.

blocks.zh: 附录J. 主论文压缩的材料

blocks.en: The following passages give the details condensed out of the main paper, so that every condensed result remains documented.
blocks.zh: 以下段落给出了主论文中压缩出来的细节,这样,每一个压缩的结果都会被记录下来.

blocks.zh: J.1. 全面开发表(包括P1和CrowdDet系统)
