blocks.zh: J.2. 系统和确认细节

blocks.en: The three trackers share the same saved detections from the official bytetrack_x_mot17 YOLOX-X checkpoint distributed with ByteTrack [3,19]. They are ByteTrack, OC-SORT, and BoT-SORT without ReID [3,4,5]. The documented detector training excludes MOT20. Export uses 800 × \times 1440 inputs, score threshold 0.01, and NMS 0.7. Each tracker uses its authors’ fixed MOT17 settings, including its own admission threshold, output filtering, and camera-motion handling.
blocks.zh: 三大追踪器共享官方bytetrack_x_mot17 YOLOX-X检查站发布的相同保存的探测器[3,19]. 它们是ByteTrack、OC-SORT和没有ReID的BOT-SORT[3,4,5]。 记录的探测器训练不包括MOT20。 出口使用800×\时数1440输入,分数阈值0.01,NMS0.7. 每个跟踪器使用其作者的固定的 MOT17 设置,包括自己的录用阈值,输出过滤和相机动作处理.

blocks.en: The YOLOX composite admits detections at 0.10, runs index-corrected ByteTrack at high/low/new thresholds 0.25/0.10/0.25, then stitches fragments (M4) and applies the counting rules. The CrowdDet composite applies the same later steps to CrowdDet inputs [20]. P2 is the original CrowdDet baseline with admission at 0.25. O1 feeds reference full-body boxes to the fixed tracker and counting rules. The study trains no model weights.
blocks.zh: YOLOX复合体在0.10时接受检测,在高/低/新阈值下运行指数校正的ByteTrack,然后缝合碎片(M4)并应用计数规则. CrowdDet复合体对CrowdDet输入应用了相同的后期步骤[20]. P2是最初的CrowdDet基线,录取时间为0.25. O1将参考全体箱输入固定跟踪器和计数规则. 研究没有模型重量。

blocks.en: The fixed 03/05 confirmation includes seven systems: the three trackers sharing detections, the two composites, P2, and O1. Four systems share one archived YOLOX export per sequence. We recorded hashes of inputs, code, parameters, environment, and outputs for the execution. Results depend on these cached detections because floating-point inference can vary. Earlier P1/P2 results and O1/O2 diagnostics on 03/05 had been inspected. The later seven-system execution followed a protocol fixed beforehand.
blocks.zh: 03/05固定确认包括7个系统:3个跟踪器共享检测,2个复合材料P2和O1. 四个系统共享一个存档的 YOLOX 导出每个序列. 我们记录了大量投入、代码、参数、环境和产出。 结果取决于这些缓存检测,因为浮点推论可能有所不同. 早先的P1/P2结果和03/05年的O1/O2诊断已经检查过了。 后来的七系统执行是在事先确定的一项协议之后进行的。

blocks.en: For each sequence s s , H-A requires each tracker m m among the three sharing detections to satisfy 10 ​ K l ​ o ​ w , s ​ ( m ) ≤ 7 ​ N l ​ o ​ w , s 10K_{low,s}(m)\leq 7N_{low,s} and 10 ​ K h ​ i ​ g ​ h , s ​ ( m ) ≥ 9 ​ N h ​ i ​ g ​ h , s 10K_{high,s}(m)\geq 9N_{high,s} . H-B requires the YOLOX composite’s low-visibility count to exceed the largest count among those trackers. Both sequences must pass; their combined values are descriptive. The BASE development results, repair and definition comparisons are development analyses. BASE’s 03/05 scores are an additional analysis (Appendix K).
blocks.zh: 对于每个序列 s, H-A 需要每个跟踪器 m m 在三个共享检测中满足 10千里、秒(米) ______________________________ 页:1 (m)\ leq 7N_{,s}和 10 Kh i g h,s (m)\ 9 Nh i g h,s}(m)\ 10K_{高,s}\ geq 9N_{高,s} H-B要求YOLOX复合材料的低可见度计数超过这些跟踪器中的最大计数. 这两个序列都必须通过;它们的综合价值是描述性的。 BASE的发展成果、修复和定义比较是发展分析。 BASE的03/05分是附加分析(附录K).

blocks.en: BASE contributes published trajectories [6]. Its setup includes a separate detector recipe, MOT20-based parameter estimation and tuning, look-ahead, and interpolation. We retain both one-based and zero-based coordinate interpretations. The release identifies the files’ source but does not link each file to a specific leaderboard submission.
blocks.zh: BASE 贡献已出版的轨迹 [6] (中文(简体) ). 它的设置包括一个单独的探测器配方,基于MOT20的参数估计和调制,前瞻,以及插值. 我们保留基于单一和零协调的解释。 发布会识别文件的来源, 但不会将每个文件链接到特定的领导板提交 。

blocks.en: An exploratory repair retains possible crossings from BASE that failed the depth check when YOLOX-composite output meets the support rules. It preserves each possible crossing’s person-ID, time, and position. Selection uses output geometry and mutual track compatibility; reference person-IDs enter only the later evaluation. We designed the selection rule after inspecting development failures. Before this exploratory run, we recorded an acceptance rule requiring at least three additional low-visibility matches under both coordinate interpretations, no high-visibility loss in either sequence, and no overall precision loss.
blocks.zh: 探索性维修保留了BASE的可能过境点,当YOLOX复合产出符合支持规则时,该过境点未能进行深度检查。 它保留每个可能的过境点的个人身份、时间和位置。 选择使用输出几何和相互轨道兼容;参考人物ID只输入后期评价. 我们在检查开发失败后设计了选择规则. 在本次探索性运行之前,我们记录了一条验收规则,要求根据两种坐标解释,至少增加三个低可见度匹配点,没有高可见度损失,没有总体精度损失。

blocks.en: A separate fixed-track comparison uses original definition O and symmetric region transitions S. O pairs final system events with references retained by the depth rule. S pairs possible crossings from system outputs before filtering with all reference transitions before the depth rule, keeping repeated traversals on both sides and removing depth checks and R1/R2. The person-ID checks and matching tolerances stay fixed. We report the original-reference subset separately from the full alternative reference set. A threshold fixed before the check determines whether to proceed to additional human review.
blocks.zh: 单独的固定轨道比较使用原始定义O和对称区域过渡S.O对称最终系统事件,引用由深度规则保留. S对在深度规则前过滤所有参考过渡之前可能从系统输出中交叉,两侧保留重复的转录,并取消深度检查和R1/R2. 个人身份检查和匹配的容忍度保持不变。 我们报告原始参考子集,与完整的替代参考集分开。 在检查确定是否进行额外的人文审查之前设定的门槛值.

blocks.en: J.3. Human-review design
blocks.zh: J.3. 人文审查设计

blocks.en: Q2 samples 40 low-visibility events missed by five earlier systems and 40 recovered by at least three. BASE entered the study later. The two people who reviewed the videos see the target and video, with system outputs and group labels hidden. They judge whether any body part is visible before and after, and whether the video supports a crossing.
blocks.zh: Q2样本40次低能见度事件被之前的5个系统错过,40次被至少3个系统恢复. BASE后来进入了研究. 审查视频的两人看到目标与视频,系统输出和组标签被隐藏. 他们判断是否有身体部分在前后可见,视频是否支持过道.

blocks.en: Q3 samples by sequence and visibility after excluding Q2. Its eligible population has 644 references retained by the depth rule, including 100 low-visibility events. Its 93 items include 88 references from that list, four transitions excluded by that rule, and one open-search window. The sample from the reference list has 34 low-visibility events and 18 in each other bin. Before responses, we randomly added sixteen low-visibility MOT20-02 items under a recorded rule. The two people who reviewed the videos judge whether a crossing occurred, its direction, whether the person remained the same, and whether its time can be determined. They may record supporting time intervals.
blocks.zh: 在排除Q2后,按顺序和能见度排列Q3样本. 其符合条件的人口有深度规则保留的644个参考文献,包括100个低可见度事件. 其93个项目包括该清单的88个参考文献、该规则排除的4个过渡和一个开放搜索窗口。 参考列表中的样本有34个低可见度事件,18个互在bin. 在回复之前,我们随机在记录规则下增加了16个低可见度的MOT20-02项. 审阅视频的两人判断是否发生过路,路由,当事人是否保持不变,以及时间能否确定. 它们可以记录支持时间间隔。

blocks.en: The two people who reviewed the videos submitted initial answers separately, then discussed disagreements. Person A discussed definitions and illustrated examples with an assistant while completing the initial answers; the joint-review page displayed AI answers for reference. The primary analysis uses initial answers. Q3 support requires both people to endorse occurrence, agree that the person stayed the same, and give a direction compatible with the reference. An explicit rejection of occurrence or of the person remaining the same, or an incompatible direction, counts as a conflict. Incomplete or uncertain support remains unresolved. We link these judgments to saved matches at the fixed reference times.
blocks.zh: 两人分别提交了初步答案, 个人 一份讨论过的定义和在完成初步答复时与一名助理举例说明的例子;联合审查网页显示AI答复,以供参考。 主要分析采用初步答案。 Q3支持要求双方认可发生,同意当事人保持不变,并给出与引用一致的方向. 明确拒绝发生或拒绝当事人保持不变或方向不一致的行为,均视为冲突。 不完整或不确定的支助仍未解决。 我们把这些判断与固定参考时间的保存匹配联系起来。

blocks.en: J.4. Repair accounting
blocks.zh: J.4. 修理会计

blocks.en: The repair adds six or five low-visibility matches, keeps all earlier matches, and leaves high-visibility counts unchanged. Across all bins, it adds 25 or 21 final reports and 14 or 12 matched references. Eleven or nine additions remain unmatched. Of these, 9/11 and 8/9 are compatible with saved transitions excluded from the reference list by the depth rule. Each coordinate interpretation also adds one report under the category that ignores person-IDs; the one-based version adds one report without an eligible same-person reference transition.
blocks.zh: 修补增加了6或5个低能见度匹配,保持所有早期匹配,高能见度计数不变. 在所有垃圾箱中,它增加了25或21份最后报告和14或12份相应的参考文献。 十一或九增无比. 其中,9/11和8/9与深度规则排除于参考列表中的保存的过渡兼容. 每个坐标解译还增加了一个忽略个人ID的类别下的报告;一个版本增加了一个报告,没有合格的同人参考过渡.

blocks.en: Precision falls under both coordinate interpretations, so the repair fails the protocol’s no-precision-loss condition. Most added unmatched reports align with transitions excluded by the reference depth rule. This explains their precision cost under the fixed reference list. Whether those reports describe useful physical passages needs further evidence. Main-paper Figure 3 shows the two kinds of remaining miss: a possible crossing that fails the depth check and a track in which the counting rules find no possible crossing.
blocks.zh: 精确度属于两种协调解释的范围,因此修复失败了协议的无精度损失条件. 增加的多数未匹配报告与参考深度规则所排除的过渡相一致。 这解释了它们在固定参考清单下的精确成本。 这些报告是否描述了有用的实际段落,还需要进一步的证据。 主要文件 图3显示两种尚存的错失:一种是可能无法通过深度检查的过路,另一种是计数规则无法通过的道路.

blocks.en: J.5. Per-sequence effect of the relaxed definition
blocks.zh: J.5. 放宽定义的后果

blocks.en: Recall remains lower at low visibility under S. Precision changes from 95.45–95.90% to 93.55–94.44% for BASE and from 90.06% to 78.86% for ByteTrack. Seventeen existing unmatched BASE final reports under each coordinate interpretation, and 21 ByteTrack reports, match newly included references. Both retaining possible crossings and expanding the reference list therefore contribute to the changed scores.
blocks.zh: S. 精密度从95.45-95.90%降至93.55-94.44%,BASE从90.06%降至78.86%。 每个坐标解释下现有17份未匹配的BASE最后报告和21份字节跟踪报告与新列入的参考资料相符。 因此,保留可能的过境点和扩大参考清单都有助于改变分数。

blocks.en: The effect varies by sequence. Added low-visibility matches that persist under both BASE coordinate interpretations number zero on 01 and twelve on 02; ByteTrack adds three and nine. The threshold for further human review required at least two on 01 and eight on 02 for each system, involving at least two people in each comparison. Three of four comparisons passed, so the study stopped before expanding human review. The scores are sensitive to the definition under the tested outputs, but the required improvement across all conditions was not met.
blocks.zh: 效果因顺序而异. 在BASE坐标解释编号01为0,02为12为0,在ByteTrack中添加的低可见度匹配持续;ByteTrack增加了3和9. 进一步人文审查的门槛要求每个系统至少在01日2人,在02日8人,每次比较至少涉及两人. 4个比较中有3个通过,因此研究在扩大人类审查之前就停止了. 评分对所测试产出下的定义很敏感,但没有满足所有条件的改进要求。

blocks.en: J.6. Outcome-selected visibility audit (Q2)
blocks.zh: J.6. 成果选择可见度审计(问题2)

blocks.en: In Q2, both people initially support the crossing for 18/40 items missed by all earlier systems and 35/40 controls. For each supported item, both report some body part visible before and after. The prespecified complete-invisibility criterion fails: the common-miss subset has fewer than the required twenty supported passages, and the invisibility bounds fail their conditions. The supported subset therefore contains visible information. Unsupported and uncertain items remain in the original sample. Seeing a body part does not establish the precise foot position or event time.
blocks.zh: 在问题2中,两人最初都支持通过18/40个被所有早期系统错过的物项和35/40控制. 对于每个支持的项目,都报告前后可见的某些身体部分。 预设的完全隐形标准失败:常见误差子集比要求的二十个支持段落少,隐形限值会使其条件失效. 因此,所支持的子集包含可见的信息. 不支持和不确定的项目仍留在原始样本中。 身体部位不能确定准确的足部位置或事件时间.

blocks.en: J.7. Diagnostic controls, matching ambiguity, and frame metrics
blocks.zh: J.7. 诊断控制、匹配模糊度和框架衡量标准

blocks.en: Deleting observations changes recovery even when their number is held fixed. At requested retention 0.5, dispersed deletion gives overall recall near 0.896 on both development sequences; contiguous deletion gives approximately 0.224–0.225. Deleting thirteen consecutive observations leaves 0.56 s between the retained endpoints, exceeding the 0.5 s reset in the counting rules. The curves therefore reflect where observations are missing in time and how the complete processing chain responds.
blocks.zh: 删除观测即使其数量被固定,也会改变回收情况。 按要求保留0.5, 分散删除使两个开发序列的总体回顾近0.896;连续删除约0.224-0.225。 删除连续13个观测值,在保留终点之间留下0.56秒,超过计数规则中0.5秒重置. 因此,曲线反映了及时缺失观测的地方以及完整的处理链是如何反应的.

blocks.en: The head-observation diagnostic, check of possible crossings across gaps, and relinking test using reference person-IDs all fail their recorded conditions for proceeding. Fixed BoT-SORT ReID changes low-visibility recovery from 84 to 81. Removing M4 from the YOLOX composite gives 97/180, against 99/180 for the full configuration. Independent checks cover these results within the scope described in Appendix B.2. The head diagnostic uses the same-video head annotations described by Sundararaman et al. [22].
blocks.zh: 头-观察诊断、检查可能跨越空白之处,以及使用参考人识别符重新连接测试都未能达到记录的程序条件。 固定的BOT-SORT ReID将低可见度回收从84个改为81个. 从 YOLOX 复合材料中移除 M4 时给出97/180,而全配置为99/180. 独立检查涵盖附录B.2所述范围内的这些结果。 头部诊断使用Sundararaman等人描述的同声视频头部说明[22].

blocks.en: All equally optimal matches give the same bin counts in the primary mode that checks person-IDs; counts can differ when person-IDs are ignored. Standard frame metrics also decrease at low visibility. Across the two confirmation sequences, three of 56 metric comparisons meet the recorded thresholds for a ranking reversal. All concern ByteTrack and BoT-SORT on sequence 05. BoT-SORT scores higher on HOTA, IDF1, and low-visibility frame person-ID recall; ByteTrack recovers five more low-visibility crossings, exactly the required difference. The sequence-03 comparisons do not meet these thresholds. This is a local example of the metrics ranking systems differently, with limited evidence for a broader ranking effect.
blocks.zh: 所有同样最佳的匹配在主模式下给出相同的bin计数,以检查人物ID;当人物ID被忽略时,计数可能有所不同. 低能见度标准框架衡量标准也有所下降。 在整个两个确认序列中,56个度量比较中有3个符合记录的排位逆转阈值。 所有与ByteTrack和BOT-SORT在05序列有关. BOT-SORT在HOTA,IDF1和低可见框人名ID召回上的分数较高;ByteTrack恢复了另外5个低可见度的交叉点,正好是所需的差数. 序列03的比较不符合这些阈值. 这是衡量系统排名不同的地方实例,对更广泛的排名效应的证据有限。

blocks.en: J.8. Artifact scope and data handling
blocks.zh: J.8. 人工杀伤范围和数据处理

blocks.en: The released resource lets readers inspect the reported results. Its standalone development tools rebuild 01/02 labels and score compatible output tracks. The inspector shows final matches and nearby output boxes linked to the person. Confirmation outputs, counting-rule records, and later analyses linking BASE and human judgments are archived separately. Fresh-clone checks ran on the same machine; reproduction on a different machine has not been tested. The four-option repair check found no advantage over the best fixed recommendation under the same per-sequence acceptance rule, and stopped (Appendix G). The recorded stages identify which operation could affect a case. The repair failed its adoption criterion and the selection check found no advantage. The value of these records for choosing repairs remains unresolved.
blocks.zh: 释放的资源让读者检查报告的结果。 它的独立开发工具重建了01/02标签并得分兼容输出音轨. 视察员显示最终火柴和与该人相连的附近输出框。 将确认产出、计数规则记录以及日后将BASE与人类判断联系起来的分析分别归档。 同一机器上的新鲜杂质检查;另一机器上的复制没有经过测试。 四选修检查发现,在相同的按顺序接受规则下,与最佳固定建议相比没有优势,因此停止(附录G). 记录的阶段确定哪些行动可能影响案件。 修复未能达到采纳标准,选择检查发现没有优势. 这些记录用于选择修理的价值仍未解决。

blocks.en: The public-data study uses MOT20 under its documented terms. Derived labels retain CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 attribution; code and upstream components retain their respective licenses. The research package contains numerical derivatives and reconstruction tools. Users obtain original public videos and model weights from their providers. Private stadium videos and individual human answers remain outside the public package. Person-IDs are dataset track IDs. Stadium results pair crossings by time and position because person-ID ground truth is unavailable.
blocks.zh: 公共数据研究根据文献术语使用MOT20. 衍生标签保留了CC BY-NC-SA 3.0归属;代码和上游组件保留各自的许可证。 该研究包包含数字衍生工具和重建工具. 用户从其提供商那里获得原始的公共视频和模型权重. 私人体育场的视频和个人的答案仍然在公共节目包之外. 人物ID是数据集轨迹ID. 体育场按时间和位置进行对接,因为个人身份的地面真相不存在。

blocks.en: Appendix K. Analyses added after the fixed confirmation
blocks.zh: 附录K. 固定确认后增加的分析

blocks.en: We ran two additional analyses on 9 November 2026, after the fixed confirmation in main-paper Section 4 and the development analyses. Both preserve the confirmation decision and all earlier scores.
blocks.zh: 2026年11月9日,我们在主要文件第4节的固定确认和发展分析之后又进行了两项分析。 既保留了确认决定,又保留了以前所有的分数.

blocks.en: K.1. BASE on MOT20-03/05
blocks.zh: K.1. MOT20-03/05上的基准

blocks.en: The BASE release used for the development trajectories [6] also provides MOT20-03 and MOT20-05 trajectories at the same repository commit. We scored them against the confirmation references with the counting rules, person-ID checks and matching unchanged. Before scoring 03/05, the new input adapter had to reproduce BASE’s saved development results under both coordinate interpretations. Every gate’s events, person-IDs assigned to boxes in each frame, matches and scores agreed. BASE’s parameters were fitted on the MOT20 training sequences, including 03 and 05. Table K1 therefore reports outputs on sequences already used by BASE. These are additional results, outside the held-out setting and outside H-A and H-B.
blocks.zh: 用于开发轨迹的BASE发布[6]也在同一寄存器上提供了MOT20-03和MOT20-05轨迹. 我们用计数规则、人身份检查和匹配的确认书打分 在03/05评分之前,新的输入适配器必须在两个坐标解释下复制BASE节省的发展成果. 每个大门事件、指定每个框框的人物身份、匹配和得分都一致。 BASE的参数安装在MOT20训练序列上,包括03和05。 因此,表K1报告了BASE已经使用的序列的产出。 这些都是额外的结果,在被搁置的情况下和H-A和H-B之外。

blocks.en: On MOT20-03/05, BASE recovers a larger fraction of low-visibility crossings than on the development sequences (78.2–78.5% against 63.3–63.9%), and a gap of about 21 points to high visibility remains.
blocks.zh: 在MOT20-03/05上,BASE恢复了比在开发序列上更大的一小部分低可见度的交叉点(78.2–78.5%对63.3–63.9 %),还有约21点的缺口仍然保持高可见度.

blocks.en: By sequence, BASE’s low-visibility recall is 75.0–78.1% on 01, 60.1–61.5% on 02, 76.5% on 03 and 79.0–79.4% on 05 (01 and 02 from Appendix E). MOT20-02 contains 148 of the 180 low-visibility development references and has the lowest recall.
blocks.zh: 按顺序,BASE的低能见度召回率为01:75.0–78.1%,02:60.1–61.5%,03:76.5%,05:79.0–79.4%(附录E中的01和02)。 MOT20-02包含了180个低能见度发展参考文献中的148个,并且召回率最低.

blocks.en: K.2. Stage breakdown for further systems
blocks.zh: K.2. 进一步系统的阶段分解

blocks.en: We followed the order in main-paper Section 3.4 when checking saved records from the three trackers sharing detections on all four sequences, the YOLOX composite on 03/05, and BASE on 03/05. The categories, their order, the ± \pm 25-frame window and matching tolerances remain the same as for BASE on the development sequences; Table K2 repeats those development counts. Records for the three trackers on 01/02 come from the run used in main-paper Table 1, and 03/05 records come from the confirmation run. In every comparison, the saved low-visibility match count agrees with main-paper Table 1, main-paper Table 2 or Table K1. We omit the composite on 01/02 because its saved counting-rule records come from a later regression run with one mid-low match different from main-paper Table 1.
blocks.zh: 我们在检查所有四个序列上共享检测的3个追踪器保存的记录时遵循了主要文件第3.4节的顺序,即2005年3月的YOLOX复合材料和2005年3月的BASE。 类别,它们的顺序,±\pm 25帧窗口和匹配的容限与BASE在开发序列上保持不变; 表K2重复这些开发计数. 2002年1月1日的3个追踪器的记录来自主纸表1所用的运行,2005年3月的记录来自确认运行. 在每次比较中,节省下来的低可见度匹配计数与主纸表1,主纸表2或表K1一致. 我们省略了2002年1月1日的复合数据,因为其保存的计数规则记录来自后来的回归运行,一个中低的匹配率不同于主纸表1。

blocks.en: Across 03/05, the composite misses 243 low-visibility crossings. Categories A and B account for 132 (54.3%), and category C for 42 (17.3%). By sequence, A and B account for between 45.6% of misses (BoT-SORT on 02) and all seven (BASE on 01, one-based reading). Category C accounts for at most 34.4% (BASE on 03, one-based reading).
blocks.zh: 在2005年3月30日,这些综合设施错过了243个低可见度过境点。 A和B类占132(54.3%),C类占42(17.3%)。 按顺序,A和B分别占错失(BOT-SORT于02)和全部7(BASE于01,单读)的45.6%. C类最多占34.4%(BASE于03,单读).
